instruction: BGA Fan-Out Grid The file design.kicad_pcb contains a 15x15 BGA footprint (U1, 225 pads at 0.8mm pitch) placed at the center of the board. Rows are labeled A-O, columns 1-15. Rows F through J (inner rows) carry ground signals. Currently there are no vias. Add fan-out vias to the PCB following the dog-bone escape routing pattern and write the result as design.kicad_pcb. Requirements: 1. Add exactly one via per BGA pad (225 vias total). 2. For ground pads (rows F-J): place vias at the pad center (via-in-pad style) with drill diameter <= 0.2mm, and set the tented property. 3. For signal pads (all other rows): place each via at a 45-degree diagonal offset from the pad center (dog-bone pattern). The offset distance should be approximately 0.566mm from the pad center. 4. The dog-bone offset direction should alternate: use one diagonal direction for even row indices (A, C, E, K, M, O) and a different diagonal for odd row indices. 5. No two vias may share the same position (via centres must all be distinct). Write /home/user/Desktop/answer.kicad_pcb.

command: import pyautogui; import time; RATIO_X = 0.589; RATIO_Y = 0.726; time.sleep(5); screen_w, screen_h = pyautogui.size(); x = int(screen_w * RATIO_X); y = int(screen_h * RATIO_Y); pyautogui.click(x, y); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click(x, y); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click(x, y)
